name: DeepScholar-bench
description: A live benchmark and automated evaluation framework for generative research synthesis systems that generate long-form, cited reports by retrieving and synthesizing information from the live web. It evaluates performance across knowledge synthesis, retrieval quality, and verifiability.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the DeepScholar work, so it is not yet widely established as a standard community leaderboard.
notes: Live benchmark using recent ArXiv papers; measures synthesis, retrieval, and verifiability; no system surpasses 31% geometric mean across metrics.
